title: Soaring Symbols airlines
description: The airline catalog in airlines.json, as kept in the repo. The build adds `assets` to every entry of the copy it publishes, `history` to those with older marks, `slug` to each name in `former` with another slug, the deprecated `previous_names` and `previous_slugs` to renamed ones and `predecessors` to those that carried on a defunct airline (see $defs/published); leave them out of the repo.

published.description: The catalog the package ships in dist/airlines.json: every entry also has `assets`, `history` when it has older marks, a `slug` on each name in `former` with another slug, the deprecated `previous_names` and `previous_slugs` when it was renamed, and `predecessors` when it carried on a defunct airline.

alliance.description: An airline alliance; an airline counts as in one when it is a member itself, not an affiliate flying under another member's membership.

allianceMembership.description: An alliance the airline was a member of: the year it joined, when known, and the year it left.

since.description: Year the airline joined the alliance.

until.description: Year the airline left the alliance.

callsign.description: ICAO radiotelephony callsign in uppercase, accented letters included, e.g. "VIET NAM AIRLINES" or "LAN PERÚ".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (or an ISO 3166-2 subdivision such as "GB-SCT"); several are comma-separated without spaces, e.g. "DK,NO,SE".

former.description: A name or codes the airline used before: at least one of `name`, `iata`, `icao` and `callsign`, and the year it stopped using them.

name.description: A name the airline flew under before.

slug.description: Added by the build when the name's slug differs from the airline's: getAirline() finds the airline by it. Only in the published catalog.

until.description: Year the airline stopped using this name or these codes.

name.description: Full name of the airline; the array is sorted by it.

slug.description: Identifier of the airline and the name of its assets/<slug>/ folder. Must be the slugified name; `npm run generate` fills it in when missing.

previous_names.description: Deprecated, to be removed in 0.4: read the names in `former`. Added by the build: the names in `former`, oldest first. Only in the published catalog.

previous_slugs.description: Deprecated, to be removed in 0.4: read `former[].slug`. Added by the build: the slugs of the names in `former` that differ from `slug`. getAirline() finds the airline by them, and the package also ships its current files under assets/<previous slug>/. Only in the published catalog.

iata_duplicate.description: The IATA code is a controlled duplicate: IATA gave the same code to another airline whose services don't overlap, and marks this holder with an asterisk ("SL*" for SAS Connect, whose SL Thai Lion Air also holds). Only this holder may share the code with another active airline, and getAirline() finds the other one by it; find this one by the code with the asterisk ("SL*"), its ICAO code, slug or name.

former.description: The names and codes the airline used before its current ones, oldest first, each with the year it stopped using them, e.g. [{ "name": "Jat Airways", "icao": "JAT", "callsign": "JAT", "until": 2013 }] for Air Serbia. Each item lists only what changed then. getAirline() finds the airline by its former names and slugs, and by its former codes when no airline has them now.

alliance.description: The alliance the airline is a member of now, or was when it ceased.

alliance_history.description: Alliances the airline was a member of before its current one, oldest first, e.g. [{ "alliance": "Star Alliance", "since": 1997, "until": 2024 }] for Scandinavian Airlines.

parent.description: Slug of the airline group in this catalog that this one is a subsidiary of: the airline that owns it, or whose network it flies in, e.g. "airasia" for Thai AirAsia or "jetstar" for Jetstar Japan.

marks.description: Slug of the airline whose SVGs this one uses, when it has none of its own: often the parent, or a sibling that shares a different logo. The build copies those files to this airline's slug.

hubs.description: IATA codes of the airline's hub airports, e.g. ["HAN", "SGN"]. Operating bases of low-cost carriers are not hubs.

founded.description: Year the airline (or the predecessor it counts its history from) was founded.

ceased.description: Year a defunct airline ceased operations.

successor.description: Slug of the airline that carried on this defunct one after a merger, a refounding, or a move into or out of a group's brand, e.g. "air-india" for Vistara. A plain rename keeps the entry and lists the old name in `former` instead.

predecessors.description: Added by the build: slugs of the defunct airlines whose `successor` is this one, oldest first; only in the published catalog.

assets.description: Added by the build from the SVGs; only in the published catalog.

history.description: Added by the build from assets/<slug>/history/<year>/ when the airline has older marks; only in the published catalog.

branding.description: An airline's branding: always with its primary color.

brandingFields.description: The branding fields airlines and alliances share; an alliance may leave out primary_color until its marks are in the collection.

since.description: Year the current marks were introduced. Required when the airline has older marks in history/, whose last one was used until this year.

guidelines.description: Link to the airline's brand guidelines.

assets.description: Added by the build from the files in assets/<slug>/.

history.description: The marks an airline used before its current ones, oldest first, each from `since` until `until`; its files are at assets/<slug>/history/<since>/.

since.description: Year the mark was introduced, also its folder name.

until.description: Year the next mark replaced it: the next entry's `since`, or the airline's `branding.since` for the last one.

name.description: The airline's name on this mark (its SVG title): the current name, or a former one for a mark used before a rename.
